own.body: Every job on this page is ours. We would rather show you the work than describe it.

generic.heading: The work, in four pictures
generic.body: Solar, storage, hot water and commercial — the four things we are asked for most.

items.title: Sized from your data, not a package
items.body: We read your bill and interval data before proposing a system, so the design matches how you actually use power rather than an average household.

items.title: Quotes that show their working
items.body: System size, product list, each rebate as a separate line, and the assumptions behind the payback figure. All of it checkable.

items.title: Victorian networks understood
items.body: Five distribution networks with five different export limits. We confirm yours before finalising system size, not after installation.

processSection.heading: From first call to switched-on system
processSection.body:
You send a recent bill. We come back with a design, a price after rebates, and the assumptions behind the payback figure.

If the numbers do not work for your property, we tell you that instead of selling you a system anyway.
processSection.imageAlt: An electrician working on a home switchboard

bullets.title: Send your bill
bullets.body: Or your interval data if you have it — it makes the sizing exact rather than estimated.

bullets.title: Get a design and a price
bullets.body: System size, product list, each rebate itemised, and payback with its assumptions shown.

bullets.title: Install and commission
bullets.body: Most homes are done in a day, then we set up monitoring and show you how to read it.
